entries.title: Psalms 34:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed.>> I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise [shall] continually [be] in my mouth. {Abimelech: or, Achish}

entries.title: Psalms 34:2
segments: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear [thereof], and be glad.

entries.title: Psalms 34:3
segments: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.

words.text: with me, and let us exalt

entries.title: Psalms 34:4
segments: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

entries.title: Psalms 34:5
segments: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed. {were lightened: or, they flowed unto him}

words.text: . {were lightened: or, they flowed unto him}

entries.title: Psalms 34:6
segments: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard [him], and saved him out of all his troubles.

words.text: him out of all his troubles

entries.title: Psalms 34:7
segments: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

entries.title: Psalms 34:8
segments: O taste and see that the LORD [is] good: blessed [is] the man [that] trusteth in him.

entries.title: Psalms 34:9
segments: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for [there is] no want to them that fear him.

entries.title: Psalms 34:10
segments: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good [thing].

entries.title: Psalms 34:11
segments: ¶Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 34:12
segments: What man [is he that] desireth life, [and] loveth [many] days, that he may see good?

entries.title: Psalms 34:13
segments: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

entries.title: Psalms 34:14
segments: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

entries.title: Psalms 34:15
segments: The eyes of the LORD [are] upon the righteous, and his ears [are open] unto their cry.

entries.title: Psalms 34:16
segments: The face of the LORD [is] against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 34:17
segments: [The righteous] cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

words.text: them out of all their troubles

entries.title: Psalms 34:18
segments: The LORD [is] nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit. {unto...: Heb. to the broken of heart} {of a contrite...: Heb. contrite of spirit}

words.text: unto them that are of a broken
such as be of a contrite
. {unto...: Heb. to the broken of heart} {of a contrite...: Heb. contrite of spirit}

entries.title: Psalms 34:19
segments: Many [are] the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.

entries.title: Psalms 34:20
segments: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

entries.title: Psalms 34:21
segments: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate. {desolate: or, guilty}

entries.title: Psalms 34:22
segments: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate. {desolate: or, guilty}

words.text: : and none of them that trust
